groups.place: HEART OF DEIMOS, THEN THE WAR WITHIN

rows.label: Heart of Deimos
rows.note: unlocks Cambion Drift, the Necralisk and the Entrati

rows.label: The War Within
rows.note: Operator access; needed for vault doors, Requiem Obelisks and Necramech Transference

bonuses: Completing Heart of Deimos mails the Voidrig main blueprint plus all four component blueprints free, retroactively even on an old completion.

groups.activity: build the four components, then Voidrig
groups.meta: 15,000 cr and 12h each component; 25,000 cr and 72h for Voidrig

rows.label: Casing
rows.note: 1 Damaged Casing, 60 Adramal Alloy, 30 Faceted Tiametrite, 140 Lucent Teroglobe

rows.label: Engine
rows.note: 1 Damaged Engine, 50 Tempered Bapholite, 4 Parasitic Tethermaw, 10 Orokin Cells

rows.label: Capsule
rows.note: 1 Damaged Pod, 3 Morphics, 12 Spinal Core Section, 50 Devolved Namalon

rows.label: Weapon Pod
rows.note: 1 Damaged Weapon Pod, 3 Biotic Filter, 40 Purified Heciphron, 30 Purged Dagonic

bonuses: Collect every material first, then queue all four components at once: one 12-hour wait instead of four run back to back.
Necraloid still sells all four blueprints as a backstop even though Heart of Deimos mails them free: components 2,000 standing each, main 5,000, at Rank 2 Modus.

disclosures.title: buying instead of farming
disclosures.body: Built Voidrig components sell for roughly 60-100 platinum each on Warframe Market, and several players find it faster to farm relics for that plat than to farm the mech directly. The trade-off: that route skips the Necramech mods and Entrati rank the quest chain still requires.
